equation: dX = mu1 * X * dt + sigma1 * X * dW1;  dY = mu2 * Y * dt + sigma2 * Y * dW2;  corr(dW1, dW2) = rho
diffusion_derivative: N/A (multi-dimensional; Milstein not well-defined without Levy area)
implementation_notes: 2D correlated GBM. Introduce correlation via Cholesky: dW1 = sqrt(dt)*Z1, dW_corr = rho*Z1 + sqrt(1-rho**2)*Z2, then dW2 = sqrt(dt)*dW_corr with Z1, Z2 ~ N(0,1) independent. X and Y are each multiplicative GBM updated with EM after generating correlated increments. Multi-dimensional -> EM only (Milstein requires Levy area). Per-component marginal moments are standard GBM moments; the correlation rho does not affect marginal means/variances, only the cross-correlation. State layout shape (num_paths, 2). X_0, Y_0 > 0 so no positivity guard needed.
